name: keshikyar-mobile
description: KeshikYar mobile wrapper for Android and iOS

scripts.mobile:add:android: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap add android
scripts.mobile:add:ios: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap add ios
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap sync
scripts.mobile:open:android: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.mobile:open:ios: npm run mobile:prepare && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
